name: 1v1
description: Classic one-on-one. Each player controls a full team against a single opponent to claim victory.

name: 2v2
description: Two players on each team collaborate to face another duo. A mode where cooperation is the key to success.

name: 3v3
description: Three players per team. A dynamic and strategic mode.

name: 4v4
description: Four versus four with more space and team movements.

name: 5v5
description: A very popular competitive format that requires good team coordination.

name: VOLTA Futsal
description: Futsal mode on a smaller pitch where creativity and flair take center stage.

name: No Rules
description: A free mode where no rules apply. Perfect for having fun without pressure — unleash your creativity and make your own rules!

name: Battle Royale
description: Each time a team concedes a goal, one of its players is eliminated.
special_rules: One player eliminated after each goal conceded

name: Pro Club
description: Each user controls their own avatar on the field in an 11-player team. Create your player and rise to global stardom.

name: Manager Career
description: Management mode: the player becomes a coach and manages a team across multiple seasons. Build the best team possible.

name: European Cup - Champions League
description: Take part in the Champions League with group stages and knockout rounds. Win the most prestigious trophy in Europe.

name: European Cup - Europa League
description: Play in the Europa League with a format identical to real life.

name: European Cup - Conference League
description: Take part in the Conference League, a lower-tier European competition.
